_doc: Prior for the 2026 Gauteng swing, used before any VDs are counted and as a weak prior afterwards (A_sd on the log-ratio scale; 0.35 ~ +/-35% relative uncertainty on each party's level). Once VDs are counted the swing is re-estimated from them and this prior matters less and less.
_registered_growth_doc: 2026 roll / 2024 certified roll for Gauteng; only used while no VDs are counted (afterwards estimated from counted VDs). 1.04 is an assumption (~750k new registrations nationally in 2026).

prior.name: pre-election polls (average, wide)
sources: Social Research Foundation, Q1 2026 Gauteng (registered voters): DA 37, ANC 31, ActionSA 7, EFF 5
